points: Led the pillar's GenAI initiative as technical lead of a 5-person team, owning the roadmap, architecture and delivery from use-case discovery to production.

Partnered with business, product and analytics stakeholders to qualify GenAI use cases, define success metrics and build ROI cases; ran feasibility spikes on real data to drive go/no-go decisions before committing to build.

Built a Snowflake analytics agent (LangGraph, Cortex Analyst) that replaced manual custom-dashboard builds in a legacy reporting system due for decommissioning, cutting creation time from ~15 min to under 1 min (p95).

Raised text-to-SQL accuracy from ~60% to ~80% by building the semantic layer first: ran metric-definition workshops with data owners to settle conflicting KPIs (e.g. ROAS) as governed metrics in per-client semantic views; 90%+ before launch, improving further via golden-set growth and user feedback.

Made agent output verifiable: generated SQL passes a sqlglot read-only guard and runs as the signed-in user; code-based critics check each chart spec against real columns and each narrative number against the result.

Built shared sign-in and tenancy for agents and web apps used by multiple clients and internal agencies: Entra ID SSO, OAuth 2.0 On-Behalf-Of token exchange into Snowflake External OAuth, SCIM provisioning and per-client roles, so row-access and masking policies apply per user; data exposed to agents as tenant-scoped MCP tools.

Designed multi-agent workflows in LangGraph and PydanticAI: Claude Sonnet on Bedrock for planning, reasoning and tool use, GPT via the OpenAI API, and intent routing that moved from Llama 3 on Bedrock to a fine-tuned Llama 3.2 1B classifier on SageMaker, behind a LiteLLM model gateway.

Built multi-tenant RAG services (Python/FastAPI) serving 1K+ daily queries: self-hosted BGE embeddings (bge-large-en-v1.5) on SageMaker, tokenizer-sized chunks, BM25 + HNSW hybrid search fused with RRF (sub-200 ms p95 retrieval) and cross-encoder reranking over Qdrant and MongoDB Atlas, streaming cited answers over SSE.
Cut LLM inference spend by ~40% through semantic caching on ElastiCache (Redis), prompt caching, cost-aware model routing and per-tenant token budgets in DynamoDB.

Built event-driven RAG ingestion in which MSK and EventBridge events carrying S3 references trigger Step Functions and Lambda pipelines for chunking, embedding and tenant-scoped upserts, keeping answers current without batch re-indexing.

Hardened RAG and agent workflows against OWASP LLM Top 10 risks with Bedrock Guardrails for PII/DLP, the fine-tuned Llama 3.2 1B classifier (Hugging Face, PyTorch) for prompt-injection and topic filtering, and entitlement-aware retrieval for tenant isolation.

Established evaluation and observability: DeepEval suites on versioned golden datasets (LLM-as-judge, faithfulness and hallucination metrics) as CI release gates, Langfuse and OpenTelemetry tracing per agent step, and shadow/canary rollouts with human-in-the-loop approvals, kill switches, audit trails, AI risk assessments and model/system cards.
Built LLM-based anomaly detection and a data-quality scoring engine, reducing undetected data-quality issues by ~75%.

Architected and led a multi-module Spring Boot 3 microservices platform (JWT/OAuth 2.0, OpenAPI) over PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Snowflake and MongoDB, with DB-, collection- and row-level tenant isolation and zero cross-tenant leakage across 12+ environments; tuned tail latency with async I/O, parallel queries and tiered caching (Caffeine, Redis).

Built MSK (Kafka) pipelines streaming ad performance, spend and conversion events from Google Ads, Meta, Bing Ads and Adverity, with per-campaign ordering, idempotent upserts, jittered retries, replayable dead-letter queues and Kinesis Data Firehose landing raw events in S3.
Built a 40+ component design system across React, Angular and Next.js, adopted by 6 internal products, with white-label theming for 5+ brands and AG Grid tables for self-serve analytics.

Owned CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm; EKS with KEDA and Karpenter autoscaling, ECS; Kyverno policies and Cosign-signed images; Jenkins and GitHub Actions with SonarQube gates), cutting merge-to-deploy time from hours to under 20 minutes.
Cut MTTR by ~50% with CloudWatch, X-Ray, Datadog and Grafana dashboards and tracing; maintained 1,000+ unit and 100+ E2E tests at 80%+ coverage across Java, Python and UI layers.

Mentored 5 engineers (3 promoted to mid-level), set coding and code-review standards across Python, TypeScript and Java, and introduced architecture decision records and incident runbooks so the team could operate and roll back systems independently.

RAG Core Platform (PoC): Config-driven RAG framework with 159 swappable components and 20+ reference pipelines, gated by CI evals; hybrid search outperformed dense-only retrieval on Recall@5 across a 120-query golden set. Secure by default: document-level ACLs, PII redaction, guardrails, a tamper-evident audit log and signed builds.

Agentic AI Core Platform (PoC): Spec-driven agent framework with 60+ swappable components and 8 orchestration patterns, gated by trajectory evals on a 150-task suite. Secure by default: MCP tool permissions, human-in-the-loop approvals, budget caps, sandboxed execution, prompt-injection guardrails and a tamper-evident audit log.

AI-Assisted E2E Test Automation: Built reusable Cursor skills that generate test scenarios, map them to Zephyr test cases and auto-create Playwright end-to-end tests, run on every pull request to block regression bugs before merge.
Worked directly with the company owner in weekly syncs to scope and prioritise high-ROI features, digitising timesheets and contracts and reducing payroll disputes.

Architected and owned a progressive web app for construction operations on Azure (App Service, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Functions, Blob Storage, AD B2C), serving 200+ daily active users across 10+ sites.

Built a mobile-first Angular PWA with offline support (Service Workers, Cache API) for field workers, improving daily task completion by 40%, backed by Node.js/Express APIs with sub-100 ms p95 responses.
Delivered CI/CD with Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker and Bicep, cutting deployment time from 2 hours to 12 minutes.
Led migration of a US telecom client's legacy Java EE monolith to a layered Spring Boot architecture, reducing technical debt and remediating critical security vulnerabilities.
Migrated AngularJS 1.5 to Angular 5 incrementally (RxJS, lazy loading), achieving 3x faster initial page loads and a 65% smaller bundle.
Re-platformed Oracle schemas to PostgreSQL with optimised indexing and stored procedures, cutting query times by 65%.
Introduced test-first development (JUnit, Mockito, Selenium) to reach 85% unit-test coverage, and containerised services with Docker to support 8+ major releases consolidating legacy systems.
